notes: All files are Steamforged product imagery (miniature renders, boards, tiles, tokens, dice, dashboard section) taken from embedded image objects of the rulebook PDFs; none is a page crop, so none carries parchment, captions or the purchaser watermark. Painted key art was not extracted.

Pixel sizes are the native sizes of the embedded objects (trimmed to their alpha bounds); nothing was upscaled except the composites listed below. The source PDFs are web/low-res exports: miniatures are 150 ppi in the 2022 core, Iron Keep, Explorers and Executioner's Chariot books and 300 ppi in Phantoms, Characters, Darkroot and Black Dragon Kalameet.

Resolution: only 9 heroes are natively about 900 px or more on the long side (ast-0131-miniature-gravelord-nito.png, ast-0135-character-dashboard-lower-section-a.png, ast-0135-character-dashboard-lower-section-b.png, ast-0134-campaign-board-left-half.png, ast-0138-expansion-miniature-artorias.png, ast-0138-expansion-miniature-great-grey-wolf-sif.png, ast-0138-expansion-miniature-black-dragon-kalameet.png, ast-0134-campaign-board-right-half.png, ast-0117-mega-boss-board-kalameet-forest.png); 7 more are 700 to 880 px (ast-0138-expansion-miniature-stone-knight.png, ast-0138-expansion-miniature-stone-guardian.png, ast-0133-game-tile-bonfire-2017.png, ast-0138-expansion-miniature-executioners-chariot.png, ast-0138-expansion-miniature-smelter-demon.png, ast-0138-expansion-miniature-invader-oliver-the-collector.png, ast-0138-expansion-miniature-invader-xanthous-king-jeremiah.png). Every other hero is the largest version the sources hold. Size heroes by pixel count: at 150 ppi effective a 450 px image prints 3 in (76 mm) on its long side, at 200 ppi 2.25 in.

Composites (several small embedded token / dice / tile objects re-assembled with their page placement on a transparent ground, upsampled about 4x from 150 ppi objects, therefore soft; their large pixel sizes are not real resolution): ast-0132-token-array-souls-wounds-conditions-terrain.png, ast-0132-token-enemy-tokens.png, ast-0132-token-row-soul-and-wound-tokens.png, ast-0132-token-row-terrain-tokens.png, ast-0133-game-tile-tomb-of-giants-fan.png, ast-0136-dice-set.png. Use them small (dice set about 1.7 in, tile fan about 4.4 in, token array and token rows about 6.5 in wide for full sharpness) or as background-weight decoration.

Backgrounds: files with has_alpha=true are cut out on transparency (the soft masks include the sculpt bases). Opaque files (has_alpha=false) are rectangular with their own printed artwork to the edge, not parchment: ast-0117-mega-boss-board-kalameet-forest.png, ast-0117-mega-boss-board-executioners-chariot-arena.png, ast-0117-mega-boss-board-executioners-chariot-reverse.png, ast-0133-game-tile-tomb-of-giants-a.png, ast-0133-game-tile-tomb-of-giants-b.png, ast-0133-game-tile-tomb-of-giants-c.png, ast-0133-game-tile-tomb-of-giants-d.png, ast-0133-game-tile-bonfire-2017.png, ast-0134-campaign-board-left-half.png, ast-0134-campaign-board-right-half.png, ast-0134-campaign-board-full-strip.png, ast-0135-character-dashboard-lower-section-b.png.

Chapters 03 and 10 share the Characters-expansion class renders; chapter 12 and chapter 20 use the Phantoms summon (white resin) and invader (red resin) renders respectively. Entries marked "theme: ... (spare)" are further hero-grade renders with no chapter of their own.

Character dashboard: only the lower section (ability box, stat grid, slot labels, endurance bar) is provided; the name band of the dashboard carries a painted class portrait and is held for provenance review. The cube slots in ast-0135-character-dashboard-lower-section-a.png are transparent holes.

Card fans (AST-0137) were not extracted: every fan shows card faces with painted illustrations (provenance review). Card backs without illustrations are in assets/frames/ast-0089-card-back-*.png (124x186 to 175x300 px, too small for a hero). No hero-grade match exists for Appendix B (card amendments); use a card back at small size or a generic component image.
The 2017 bonfire tile (ast-0133-game-tile-bonfire-2017.png) and the mega-boss boards have node rings and markers printed in the artwork.
